name: Children Growing Up
overview: Scripture emphasizes the vital role of parents in diligently teaching and guiding their children in God's ways, as seen in Deuteronomy 6:7 and Proverbs 22:6, which instruct parents to train children so they will remain on the right path throughout life. The Bible acknowledges the natural folly in a child's heart but advocates for loving correction to remove it (Proverbs 22:15). Jesus Himself welcomed children and affirmed their place in God's kingdom (Luke 18:16), while Ephesians 6 highlights the importance of children obeying and honoring their parents as a commandment with a promise, reinforcing the foundation of a godly upbringing.
